provenance.note: This fixture verifies simulator state transitions only. It does not claim that the generic actor, hit labels, timings, multipliers, character skills, equipment data, or target scenario are verified game data. The bound elemental-application profile is fixed-gcsim-provisional, not official server truth or complete gcsim parity. Reaction-owned application groups, gcsim task-order parity beyond this explicit reset-before-hit boundary, particles, action-frame data, and a complete character database remain outside this fixture.
